page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.large is an x86_64 server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on external storage options, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers for multi-core and memory-bound operations. The Geekbench single-core score of 1156.0 represents average performance, but the multi-core score of 1379.0 is poor, reflecting the single physical core constraint. Memory bandwidth tests show 12.97 GB/sec for large block reads and 11.91 GB/sec for large block writes. Passmark CPU and memory scores are also low, with database operations scoring 708.59 and Redis SET operations reaching 1.7 million operations per second.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c6e.large offers an entry-level compute-oriented profile. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring dedicated CPU cycles without massive memory demands, avoiding the overhead of larger instances. However, the lack of local storage and low memory bandwidth are key tradeoffs. This instance is best suited for lightweight web serving, basic text processing, single-threaded utility scripts, and small-scale development or testing environments.
